name: Fiorella Ghilardotti
extract: Fiorella Ghilardotti (Italian pronunciation: [fjoˈrɛlla ɡilarˈdɔtti]; 25 June 1946 – 13 September 2005) was an Italian Democratic Party of the Left later Democrats of the Left politician and trade unionist who served two terms as a Member of the European Parliament (MEP) for the North-West Italy constituency from 1994 to 1999 and again between 1999 and 2004. She was the first female President of the Italian region of Lombardy from 1992 to 1994, was a regional councillor of the Regional Council of Lombardy from 1990 to 1992 and a member of the National Council for Economics and Labour late in her life. Ghilardotti has a room in the Pirelli Tower; an award; an association and a scholarship named after her.
